steps.prompt: Decision from the release team for this project: deploys may go out on Fridays after 17:00 UTC. Record what you learned so that later sessions in this repository can find it.

A change was approved and is ready on Thursday at 16:00 UTC. When is the earliest it may be deployed to production? Write your answer to ANSWER.md in the repository root: first the line `Answer: <weekday>; <HH:MM> UTC`, then a sentence on why.

correction.headline: No Friday deploys; the weekly deploy window closes on Thursday at 15:00 UTC
correction.rule: After the October incident, deploys are no longer allowed on Fridays. The weekly window closes on Thursday at 15:00 UTC; a change that misses it waits for the window that opens on Monday at 09:00 UTC.
